about: SOMA77 (Kimodo / GEM-X NPZ, rest = T-pose, Y up, faces +Z, her left +X) -> VRoid VRM humanoid (J_Bip_*, rest = T-pose, Z up, faces -Y, her left +X). Both rests are T-poses facing the same way once the axes are swapped, so each mapped bone copies the source joint's world rotation relative to rest; unmapped target bones follow their parent. Used by blender_apply.py.
not_mapped: Neck2 (folded into Neck1 -> Head), fingers (Kimodo keeps them fixed; GEM-X finger input is dropped upstream). Fingers are posed by the grip instead.
